            namePart = fName;
            extension = calculateExtension(metadata, defaultExtension);

            namePart = fName.substring(0, fName.length() - extension.length());
        }
        if (StringUtils.isBlank(namePart)) {

        namePart = namePart.replaceAll("\\A\\.+", "_");
